_doc: A2.9/A2.9a: diario de Dex, capítulo 2 tal como es HOY (lobby, upstairs, rooftop). Se reescribe en A3.4. Ver qa/README.md § Diario.

goals.text: Find a way past Adrian's security.
Ask the receptionist about Patient Zero.
Find out what's blinking down below.

notes.text: Adrian's coat: an admin keycard with his face on it. He left in a hurry. Or wants me to think so.
The receptionist panicked at 'Patient Zero'. 'A basement-level clearance topic.' Noted. Underlined.
Sticky note in Adrian's drawer: 'PZ escaped via contract exploit — check server logs.' Also: a trading terminal key.
The weather vane on the roof works a latch on the service hatch. Who wires a weather vane to a hatch? Adrian.
That blinking below the building is a server heartbeat. Something in the basement is still running.

hints: People who leave in a hurry forget things.
His coat is still on the rack.
Pick up the coat. Check the pockets.
Open the desk upstairs. Take the key.
Go up. Things on roofs point somewhere.
The weather vane is wired to something.
Use the weather vane. Force it down.
Something down there is blinking at you.
The light at the bottom of the building.
From the roof, look at the basement light.
